title: Share provisioned Vulkan SDK paths with detached VIXEN baseline worktrees
body: A fresh configure in a detached VIXEN baseline worktree attempted a duplicate ~320 MB Vulkan SDK download even though this lane already had the same SDK and windowing cache provisioned. I had to pass -DVIXEN_VULKAN_CACHE_DIR and -DVIXEN_WINDOWING_CACHE_DIR explicitly. Let baseline worktrees reuse the repo's provisioned immutable dependency caches by default, or document the supported shared-cache configure flags.

title: Windowed capture runner requires an absolute output directory
body: tools/run-vixen-windowed-captures.sh launches VIXEN and vixen_editor from each binary directory but forwards capture-output-dir as a relative path. The applications then resolve VIXEN_HUD_CAPTURE_DIR and VIXEN_EDITOR_CAPTURE_DIR against the binary working directory, and stbi_write_png fails because the prepared repository-relative destination is elsewhere. Passing an absolute capture root recovers the witness. Make the runner canonicalize capture-output-dir to an absolute path before launching either process.

title: Queue needs progress signaling for quiet long-running VIXEN captures
body: A queued Release windowed-capture run produced all seven PNGs, but the payload stayed silent while tools/run-vixen-windowed-captures.sh redirected each app log to a file. The global queue's idle-hard watchdog killed the still-running capture after 180 seconds without output (exit 75, STALL_KILLED). Running the same capture behind a small heartbeat loop that reports progress periodically keeps the payload visible to the watchdog. Provide a documented progress/heartbeat helper or support long GPU capture jobs without custom shell monitoring.

title: Calibration store tests share temp files across parallel CTest cases
body: CalibrationStoreTest uses the fixed temp path vixen_calibration_test for every case, then TearDown removes the entire directory. CTest parallel execution runs separate cases concurrently; PolymorphicPersistence lost its saved profile while another case cleaned the shared directory. Running the full suite serially avoids the race. Use a per-test unique directory or declare a shared CTest resource lock for this fixture.

title: Editor capture CTests lack cross-process serialization for shared artifacts
body: Two CTest invocations against the same build tree overlapped: the suite and a focused editor-gate run wrote the same editor capture/state-trail artifacts, producing incomplete logs and false editor assertion failures; the editor capture producer also timed out. Serializing the invocations avoids the interference. CTest resource locks only coordinate tests managed by one CTest process, so add a process-wide lock for these shared editor artifacts or make each invocation use a private capture root.

title: Windowed capture producer CTest timeout is below real DZN runtime
body: The queued serial command ctest --test-dir <merged>/build/wsl -L 'RenderGraph|SVO' --output-on-failure --parallel 1 timed out vixen_editor_capture_producer after 180.37 seconds. Its run_editor_script.log had advanced through capture tick=115 and produced several PNGs, so the configured TIMEOUT=180 in VIXEN/application/editor/CMakeLists.txt:84 is shorter than the real DZN run on this host. Retry with CTest's --timeout 600 override; if that passes, record the measured runtime and raise or parameterize the producer timeout.
